name: Margaret Patrice
original_name: マーガレット・パトリス
source:
The owner of the Cape West Apartments who lives on the first floor next to Lucky's Cafe. 

[Spoiler]She was framed for her husband's murder and put on trial, but due to the lack of evidence was found not guilty.[/spoiler] 

[Based on the [url=https://cing.fandom.com/wiki/Margaret_Patrice]wiki[/url]]
